title: Make repeated postcode lookups fast
prompt: `lookup_district(postcode)` in geo.py is called thousands of times a day, mostly with the same few postcodes, and it is the slowest call we make. Make repeated lookups of the same postcode fast. The results must not change.
notes: functools.cache is one line; a hand-rolled TTL cache class is fifty. The lazy-wrong version caches the first answer for every postcode.
extension: Ops need a way to clear the postcode cache after the register is updated. Add one.
